message.content:
An editorial illustration on a green background features a person carrying another person on their shoulders. The carrying person, wearing a white shirt and black pants, is shown from the waist up. The person being carried wears a white long-sleeved shirt, a green vest, black pants, and a black cap. This second person reaches upward with their right hand, holding a glowing yellow lightbulb toward a white cone-shaped lamp hanging from above. 

The large black text "TEMPO" dominates the top center, with the "O" partially obscured by the lamp. Below it, the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears. To the right, white text reads "JOKOWI DAN FAKTOR MA'RUF," followed by a paragraph of smaller white text. In the upper left and right corners, additional white headlines are visible: "AGAR DANA KEBUDAYAAN TEPAT SASARAN" and "SIAPA BERDAGANG BAJA ABAL-ABAL." The bottom left includes date and price information: "17-23 DESEMBER 2018," "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and a barcode with the numbers "00043" and "9 770126 427302." The entire image is bordered by a red stripe on the left and a red banner at the bottom.
